about: The Original Nick's Pizza & Beef started on Bellwood Avenue and is now run by Jasper and family on Mannheim Road, still in Bellwood. The logo says est. 1972; the family promises traditional flavors and quality ingredients, from pizza and Italian beef to smash burgers and homemade Italian ice.
tagline: Bellwood's original pizza and beef, back with Jasper and family.
signature: Nick's Special Pizza (sausage, mushroom, green pepper, onion)
hours: Mon–Thu 10 AM–10 PM; Fri–Sat 10 AM–11 PM; Sun 11 AM–8 PM (nickspizzabeef.com homepage, fetched 2026-11-10). The catering-menu PDF on the same site says Sun 12 PM–8 PM.
notes: HOURS: trail data is an unverified placeholder (11–9 / 11–11); replace with the site's hours (Sunday opening differs between homepage 11 AM and catering PDF 12 PM). SIGNATURE: trail lists 'Thin-Crust Sausage' and 'Stuffed Pizza' — neither appears on the current menu (it offers a stuffed-cheese crust add-on, not stuffed pizza). Site advertises dine-in, carry-out, delivery and drive-thru and 'Voted #1 Pizza'. The only food photo on Nick's own site is a stock cheese-pull pizza; gallery photos are from a professional shoot credited to Facebook/Foursquare on Restaurantji, most 960px wide (not upscaled). The ribs photo shows a slab; the current menu lists rib tips.
